cases.name: posix: kit_path leaves a path as it is, python3 and jq stay the binaries
cases.cmd: bash -c '. {{KIT}}/lib/platform.sh; v="C:\\a\\b"; kit_path v; printf "%s %s %s" "$v" "$(type -t python3)" "$(type -t jq)"'

cases.name: windows: a payload path with backslashes, a /c/ path and a lowercase drive all come out as C:/…
cases.cmd: bash -c 'OSTYPE=msys; CCTOOLKIT_PYTHON=python3; . {{KIT}}/lib/platform.sh; for x in "C:\\Users\\a b\\x.cs" /c/Users/x c:/x/y /d; do v=$x; kit_path v; printf "[%s]" "$v"; done'

cases.name: windows: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is rewritten on load
windows: python3 and jq become functions a child bash inherits, Python in UTF-8 mode
cases.cmd: bash -c 'OSTYPE=msys; CCTOOLKIT_PYTHON=python3; . {{KIT}}/lib/platform.sh; bash -c "printf %s-%s-%s \$(type -t python3) \$(type -t jq) \$(python3 -c \"import sys; print(sys.flags.utf8_mode)\")"'

cases.name: windows-env: nothing written outside Windows
cases.cmd: f=$(mktemp); CLAUDE_ENV_FILE=$f bash {{KIT}}/hooks/windows-env.sh </dev/null; printf 'exit=%s size=%s' $? $(wc -c <$f | tr -d ' '); rm -f $f

cases.name: windows-env: one source line in CLAUDE_ENV_FILE, never twice
cases.cmd: f=$(mktemp); for i in 1 2; do CLAUDE_ENV_FILE=$f bash -c 'OSTYPE=msys; . {{KIT}}/hooks/windows-env.sh' </dev/null; done; grep -c 'lib/platform.sh' $f; rm -f $f

cases.name: windows-env: an empty stdin and no CLAUDE_ENV_FILE exit 0
